tests.name: Two explicit queries produce only an unqualified receipt and preserve UInt64 JSON
Empty stage list and empty WCHAR arrays remain arrays
Unknown profiles and versions are rejected
Legacy sizes and missing snapshots are rejected
Qualification and atomic metadata cannot be promoted or coerced
Invalid stage counts and truncation are rejected
Record identifiers, integer ranges and WCHAR limits are checked
A second-query failure emits no partial success
The real collector parses without errors and keeps its elevation requirement
